Hana: Overlay went blank for the first 40s of the roadmap slide. Looks like the overlay controller crashed and didn't respawn.
Luis: I'm on the overlay host, seeing a segfault. Restarting the overlay service now.
Priya: Heads-up hosts: please avoid calling audience Qs until overlay is back, we can't show the Slido thread without it.
Luis: Restart command I ran:
```
systemctl restart overlay-controller.service
```
Luis: Restarted and overlay is back. Please confirm on your screens. :white_check_mark:
Martin: Confirmed on stream - overlay restored. But it caused a slight jump in visuals as we re-injected the on-screen lower-third.
Priya: Captions held during the restart to avoid duplication; resuming now. Expect ~0.7s catch-up.
Hana: Since this pushed timing, can we move Olivia's leadership Q&A to the end of the segment? Hosts asked for a clean flow. @Olivia (CEO)
Olivia (CEO): OK with moving Q&A to the end. Make an on-stage announcement and update the banner.
